1.explanation:
• architecture/model-copy-paste.md – explains the overall copy-paste mechanism in the modeler, how selections are serialized and restored.  
• architecture/boundary-event-attachment.md – details how boundary events are programmatically attached to task shapes and how that relationship should be carried over.  
• architecture/clipboard-integration.md – shows how cut/copy buffers integrate with the modelling components, and where attachment metadata must be preserved.  
• architecture/component-interaction.md – describes the hand-off between the selection tool, the element factory, and the modelling module when duplicating or pasting.  
• project/SETUP.md – provides instructions to bootstrap and run the modeler locally so you can reproduce the bug and verify any fix.
1.bug_scenario: The user selects a task that has a boundary event attached, copies (or duplicates) both together, and pastes them into the diagram. In the GIF you can see the rectangle (task) and the small circle (boundary event) being highlighted by the selection marquee. After the paste, the new boundary event is dropped next to the copied task instead of remaining attached to its edge. The broken interaction affects the copy-paste clipboard logic (selection tool, drag & drop) and the attachment behavior of boundary events on tasks.
